title: 第十一章 我是受害者，对不对？

content_zh:
一边的乌倩倩张大了小嘴居然忘记了阻止。眼中满是不可置信之意；这楚阳……就算再没出息，也不至于这样吧？不仅不敢应战，反而吓得不知所措了……
看他之前的表现，不像这种人啊。
说时迟那时快，楚阳突然大叫一声：“救命！”紧接着便好像是吓软了腿，一屁股坐了下去……
但就在这时，李剑吟一脚踩进了地上的一个奇形的洞。地面明明很平，但不知怎地，李剑吟一脚踩上去，就出现了一个洞。
那洞跟李剑吟的脚掌一样形状，一般大小，一脚踩进去，却发现居然很深，而且下面的方向与洞口居然是全然相悖的……
惨叫一声，李剑吟本来就是在全力冲刺，冲势过猛，再加上志得意满全无提防，重心全在上身，在这强猛的惯性之下，猛地扑倒在地！只听见咔嚓一声，居然将脚腕拧断了……
以楚阳千锤百炼的眼光和经验，一眼就看出了李剑吟的功夫弱点和性格弱点，布置出的陷阱，纵然是再简单，但却是抓住了最好的时机。李剑吟若是能逃出去，那……他也就不是李剑吟了。
噗的一声，李剑吟贴着地往前扑，用一种非常标准的狗吃屎的姿势，居然无巧不巧的钻到了楚阳的裤裆底下……动作很迅速很流畅！
而楚阳也正好在这时候“被吓”的一屁股坐下，于是，还算有些肉的屁股，就这么结结实实的坐在了李剑吟的脖颈上……
李剑吟又是一闷声惨叫，噗的一声，一张嘴却狠狠的啃进了泥地……
大凡人在放声惨叫的时候，嘴是张的格外大的。李剑吟娇生惯养，最是怕痛，自然张嘴更大，几乎三十几颗牙齿都露在了外面。
这一口泥土可是吃的结实之极，估计连咽喉也能堵住一半……
楚阳坐在李剑吟脖子上，直起脖子仰起脸，大声惨叫：“好痛啊啊啊……可硌死我的屁股了……”
李剑吟现在几乎一条命生生去了半条，正是最应该发出这样的惨叫的人。但李剑吟还未来得及发出声，这位身上一点伤也没有的居然竭斯底里的叫了出来。
若是从这叫声的惨烈程度来判断伤势的话，楚阳的伤定然要比李剑吟严重十倍之多！
一边的乌倩倩震惊的揉了揉眼睛，感觉还是不真实，忍不住又揉了揉……
刚才的事兔起鹘落。来不及反应，就已经落幕。
只是这结果，却是想破了脑袋也想不到为何会如此？
那得意洋洋气焰高涨的一方现在连呻吟都呻吟不出来了，而那一个劲的退缩的也在呼天抢地的喊痛。
乌倩倩再聪明，也终究只不过是一个十七八岁的少女，长大了樱桃小口，瞪圆了俏丽的大眼睛，伸出纤细的手指头哆嗦着，居然说不出话来。

太无语了……怎么会发生这种事？
这么平整的地面上怎么会出现这么一个古怪的洞？而李剑吟怎么会这么倒霉有这么凑巧的一脚踩了进去？看这洞也不深呀，以李师弟的功力和身手怎么会摔倒而且摔的这么厉害这么狼狈？
这时，楚阳一边喊痛，一边扶着腰艰难地想要站起来，看这样子，伤的不轻……
刚才没看见他受伤呀……乌倩倩心里疑惑，但还是跑过去：“楚师弟，你别乱动，我扶你起来。”
话音未落，楚阳又是长声惨叫一声，凄惨之极，似乎腰扭得很厉害，根本站不起来，刚刚把屁股抬起来撅起老高，就猛地一下又坐了下去……
又坐在脖子上……额，还是原来的位置。这一下更狠！
下面的李剑吟好不容易等到这家伙抬了抬屁股，刚刚伸着脖子抬头，想要喘口气，哪想到那刚离开的屁股再次雷霆万钧的落了下来……
悲剧的很。李剑吟刚刚抬起来的头再一次被深深地砸进了地下。发出“咔嚓”一声清脆的响声……
幸亏这里石头不多，否则，还真说不准怎么样。不过饶是如此，鼻梁骨也断了……
乌倩倩刚刚伸出手，顿时又愣住了，身子保持前附的姿势，目瞪口呆……可怜的姑娘，这一刻大脑直接短路了……
于是乎，地上两个人，楚阳呼天抢地的坐在别人脖子上，一边叫痛一边使劲的扭屁股……几乎把下面的李剑吟的脖子扭成了麻花……

content_en:
Wu Qianqian on the side opened her mouth wide and forgot to stop her. His eyes were full of disbelief; this Chu Yang...even if he never had any future, he wouldn't be like this, right? Not only did he not dare to challenge, but he was so frightened that he was at a loss...
Judging from his previous behavior, he doesn't look like this kind of person.
Soon after, Chu Yang suddenly shouted: "Help!" Then his legs seemed to be weak from fear, and he sat down...
But at this moment, Li Jianyin stepped into a strange-shaped hole in the ground. The ground was obviously flat, but somehow, when Li Jianyin stepped on it, a hole appeared.
The hole was the same shape and size as the sole of Li Jianyin's foot. When he stepped in, he found that it was very deep, and the direction below was completely contrary to the entrance of the hole...
With a scream, Li Jianyin was sprinting with all his strength, but the momentum was too strong. In addition, he was so complacent that he was not on guard. His focus was all on his upper body. Under this strong inertia, he fell to the ground! Only a click was heard, and the ankle was actually broken...
With Chu Yang's honed vision and experience, he could see Li Jianyin's kung fu and character weaknesses at a glance, and the trap he laid out, no matter how simple it was, was the best opportunity to seize it. If Li Jianyin could escape, then... he would no longer be Li Jianyin.
With a pop, Li Jianyin rushed forward close to the ground, using a very standard dog-eating posture, and unexpectedly got under Chu Yang's crotch by accident... The movement was very fast and smooth!
And Chu Yang was "frightened" at this moment and sat down, so his butt, which was still somewhat fleshy, sat firmly on Li Jianyin's neck...
Li Jianyin let out another muffled scream, and with a pop, he opened his mouth and bit into the mud...
When ordinary people scream, their mouths open extremely wide. Li Jianyin was a pampered child and was most afraid of pain, so he naturally opened his mouth wider, with almost thirty of his teeth exposed.
This mouthful of dirt is so strong that it can even block half of your throat...
Chu Yang sat on Li Jianyin's neck, straightened his neck and raised his face, screaming loudly: "It hurts so much...it hurts my butt..."
Li Jianyin had almost lost half of his life now, and he was the one who should have screamed like this. But before Li Jianyin could make a sound, the man with no injuries actually screamed out in hysterics.
If we judge the severity of the injury based on the severity of the scream, Chu Yang's injury must be ten times more serious than Li Jianyin's!
Wu Qianqian on the side rubbed her eyes in shock, but it still felt unreal, so she couldn't help but rub it again...
What just happened was like a rabbit rising and a falcon falling. Before I had time to react, it was already over.
It's just that this result is something that even if I think about it, I can't figure out why it is like this?
The one who was so proud and arrogant could not even moan now, while the one who kept flinching was also crying out in pain.
No matter how smart Wu Qianqian is, she is still just a girl of seventeen or eighteen years old. She has grown into a cherry-shaped mouth, widened her pretty eyes, stretched out her slender fingers and trembled, but she was speechless.
So speechless...How could this happen?
How could such a weird hole appear on such a flat ground? And how could Li Jianyin be so unlucky to step in by chance? It looks like the hole isn't deep. With Junior Brother Li's skill and skills, how could he fall down so hard and so embarrassingly?
At this time, Chu Yang was crying out in pain while holding on to his waist and trying to stand up with difficulty. It looked like he was seriously injured...
I didn't see him injured just now... Wu Qianqian was confused, but she still ran over: "Junior Brother Chu, don't move around. I'll help you up."
Before he finished speaking, Chu Yang screamed again. It was extremely miserable. It seemed that his waist was twisted so much that he couldn't stand up at all. As soon as he raised his buttocks and pushed Lao Gao up, he suddenly jerkedSit down again...
Sitting on the neck again... well, it's still the same position. This time it’s even more cruel!
Li Jianyin below finally waited until this guy raised his buttocks. He just stretched his neck and looked up, trying to catch his breath, but he didn't expect that the buttocks that had just left him came down again with a thunderous force...
Very tragic. Li Jianyin's head, which he had just raised, was smashed deeply into the ground again. There is a clear "click" sound...
Fortunately, there aren't many rocks here, otherwise, I really can't say what would have happened. But despite this, the bridge of the nose is also broken...
Just as Wu Qianqian stretched out her hand, she was stunned again. She kept her forward posture and was stunned... Poor girl, her brain was short-circuited at this moment...
As a result, there were two people on the ground. Chu Yang sat on the other person's neck, screaming in pain while twisting his buttocks... almost twisting Li Jianyin's neck into a twist...
